scope: Every statically generated merged-catalog work page can open a made-to-order metal-print consultation while preserving the real catalog work id and title.
fixedDefect: Catalog consultations previously resumed as BALIAN because the verification route used a four-edition hard-coded fallback. Resume now uses the stored workTitle and restores CATALOG-WORK workId and space segment.
salesBoundary: Four approved editions have immediate formal Offer eligibility. Other catalog works are purchasable only through a verified made-to-order request followed by source/preflight, regional cost and Offer approval; Checkout remains closed until those gates pass. Verified catalog requests are reported separately as preflightRequested and contribute zero qualified pipeline value until a formal Offer is approved.
offerExpansionRule: Rank verified preflight requests by catalog work. Promote a work to OFFER PREFLIGHT only after three active verified requests for that same work; never expose contact identity in the ranking.
evidenceBoundary: This proves catalog-wide consultation availability and attribution continuity. It does not prove demand, purchase intent, payment, physical proof or revenue.
